note.question: How do optimal advertising and entry timing interact in markets with peer influence?
note.overview: This paper studies optimal advertising and entry timing decisions for a new product being sold in two-segment markets in which followers are positively influenced by elites, whereas elites are either unaffected or repulsed by product popularity among followers. Key decisions in such markets are not only how much to advertise in each segment over time but also when to enter the follower segment. The paper develops a continuous-time optimal control model to examine these issues.
